injuries.name: Roman Wilson
injuries.note: Wilson (finger) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Pat Freiermuth
injuries.note: Freiermuth (calf) was added to the injury report Saturday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Tampa Bay, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: DeShon Elliott
injuries.note: Elliott (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Ramsey
injuries.note: Ramsey (wrist) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injuries.name: Jamel Dean
injuries.note: Dean (ankle) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injuries.name: Rico Dowdle
injuries.note: Dowdle (toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers after being a full participant in practice Thursday and Friday.

injuries.name: Ben Skowronek
injuries.note: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Skowronek (calf) will not play against the Buccaneers this Sunday, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

injuries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
injuries.note: The Steelers placed Pittman (foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.name: Derrick Harmon
injuries.note: The Steelers placed Harmon (foot) on injured reserve Monday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: David Sills V
injuries.note: Sills (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: Benjamin Morrison
injuries.note: Morrison (quadriceps) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: Josiah Trotter
injuries.note: Trotter (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
injuries.note: Winfield (ribs) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Sean Tucker
injuries.note: Tucker (quadriceps) is listed as questionable and considered a game-time decision for Sunday's matchup with Pittsburgh, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Baker Mayfield
injuries.note: Mayfield (thumb) will not play Sunday, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
